title: iPhone free for 4 h 54 min while 1 job waits

messages.text:
The iPhone has had no holder for 4 h 54 min (since 12:56Z; released by fix-end-bg (process hold ended)). The limit is 5 min.
Waiting on the status board: v9-1 (owner int-v8; its next step names the phone (unmarked)).
What unblocks it: the next of int-v8 takes it (node tools/lock.mjs acquire iphone --owner <you> ...).
No steward on duty (mgmt-devices is parked): the lead handles this thread (I-175).
One message per idle period; this thread closes by itself when the slot is taken (tools/idle.mjs, I-105).

This alarm is expected: the iPhone is free because you disconnected it (T-199), not because anyone is slow.
- The waiting job is the phone part of the v9.2 build test (int-v8). It starts only after you reconnect and I give the go.
- Nobody else is waiting for the phone. Its order after reconnect: v9.2 block, then the end-screen test, then the deck check.
What you need to do: nothing. Reconnect the iPhone when you want the phone tests to run.
